outcomes.statement: Every connector attempt has durable, append-only ConnectorCallObservation evidence that distinguishes requested, known success, known failure, and unresolved outcomes without transferring request ownership from ProvisioningAction.
outcomes.demo: A deterministic interrupted-call scenario commits requested before transport and leaves it unmatched; success and failure scenarios append terminal observations sharing correlation and incremented attempt values, while UPDATE and DELETE are refused for the runtime role.

outcomes.statement: Persisted connector-call summaries are privacy-safe by construction.
outcomes.demo: Property-generated provider payloads containing credentials, authorization headers, email addresses, raw PII, full provider identifiers, and arbitrary unknown fields produce only allowlisted summaries, with no raw provider body stored.

uncertainties.statement: The previous readiness assessment assigned connector evidence to ProvisioningAction and omitted a schema migration.
uncertainties.resolution: CHG-045 makes ConnectorCallObservation the provider-neutral append-only transport-evidence owner. ProvisioningAction remains the orchestration request and may be linked optionally; automated provider request or response bodies are never written to it.

uncertainties.statement: An append-only claim is incomplete unless database privileges and constraints enforce it.
uncertainties.resolution: Migration slug connector_call_observation creates the table, uniqueness and check constraints, optional ProvisioningAction link, and runtime INSERT/SELECT grants while denying UPDATE/DELETE.

uncertainties.statement: A denylist sanitizer could leak unexpected provider fields or raw bodies.
uncertainties.resolution: Construct summaries exclusively from an explicit allowlist and property-test forbidden and unknown fields; persistence failure before transport prevents the call.

uncertainties.statement: Transport sequencing must exist before the journal can be integrated.
uncertainties.resolution: The canonical story is blocked by US-056 and must be started only after that story lands. This readiness assessment can still be approved in advance because the dependency is enforced by the story/Nous execution gate rather than misclassifying the bounded child.

dependencies.reason: Connector conformance must emit the durable observation contract delivered here.
